findings.location: sources.references[0].title: Teschl, Section 9.1 pp. 181–186, described as covering self-adjoint boundary conditions for first-order differential expressions.
findings.evidence: Teschl §9.1 is the Sturm–Liouville section; equation (9.1) defines the second-order expression τf = r⁻¹(−(pf′)′ + qf), and Theorem 9.6 discusses boundary conditions for that expression. It does not describe first-order momentum expressions. The assigned consumer uses a locally proved result, but the citation description is inaccurate.
